title: Care Management for Patients With Alzheimer Disease and Their Family Caregivers
brief_summary: This is a clinical trial to test the effectiveness of current guideline for the care of older adults with Alzheimer's disease. The study focuses on the primary care setting using a nurse care manager to facilitate guideline-level care. We are hypothesizing that patients who receive guideline-level care will have fewer behavioral problems than those who receive the usual care provided in primary care settings
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Alzheimers Disease

Exclusion Criteria:

* Inability to understand English
* No telephone
